description: List the key results — the measures that say whether the objectives are being reached. Narrow to one objective with `objectiveId`. ONE PAGE per call (50 by default, 100 max): the result carries `meta` with `hasMore`, `nextCursor` and `appliedFilters`. When `meta.hasMore` is true, pass `meta.nextCursor` back as `cursor` with the SAME filters to get the next page.

cursor.description: meta.nextCursor from the previous page. Only valid with identical filters.

objectiveId.description: Only key results measuring this objective.

name: anyforge_list_key_results
title: List key results
